item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. Our mission is to prevent that outcome. We need a ban on superintelligence—not a race to build it first.

2. We cannot protect humanity by racing to build the thing that will kill us. If anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We are working for a ban because survival comes first.

3. We want a future for humanity. Superintelligence built with anything like current techniques will end that future and kill everyone on Earth. We are calling for a ban—not promises to be careful while building it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. That is why we are working toward a ban on superintelligence. We are not asking developers to race more carefully toward the same destination. We are asking governments to stop the race. No company’s ambitions, no promise of profit, and no claim of national advantage can justify putting every human life at risk. We want humanity to have a future: children growing up, communities flourishing, and generations yet to come making lives of their own. Our communications and policy work serve that purpose. We are working to prevent human extinction.
